none: PAS NLM-943179: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17; possibly Trier mint. Obverse description: Helmeted head of Roma left. Obverse inscription: [URBS] ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins. In exergue: [-]P.[-]. Diameter: 15.4mm, Weight: 1.68gms, die axis: 12
